row: Channel of the Daviess County (Kentucky) Government.  Videos of Fiscal Court Meetings, Speak Up, and other informational videos will be posted. Agendas of Meeting are in description to allow you to search for a specific issue that was on the County's agenda. Check out our subscriptions of other Community Channels on left side of page!
